entries.title: Concept A: Light & Stone, premium home builder redesign
entries.description:
Concept A "Light & Stone" is a calm, warm-mineral redesign for a high-end Australian custom home builder (Ellery & Stone is a placeholder brand; your logo, copy and imagery drop straight in).
How it meets the brief:
- Every page redesigned and live: Home, Projects (filterable grid + case study), About & Process, Contact (enquiry form + FAQ)
- Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile, coded mobile-first
- Refined type: Cormorant Garamond + Manrope. Palette: Limestone #F5F2ED, Sand #E8E1D6, Stone #CFC6B8, Bronze #9A7B5B, Charcoal #2B2A28
- Generous 8-pt spacing, premium vector architecture art (no stock photos), subtle micro-interactions: scroll reveals, button fills, image zoom, drawn underlines
- Organised components plus a handover style guide (fonts, colours, spacing, buttons, cards, fields, motion)
Files: HTML/CSS/JS source, SVG artwork, style guide; pages can be imported into Figma. Revisions welcome, and I will apply it to your existing site structure.

entries.title: Concept B: Evening Timber, dark editorial redesign
entries.description:
Concept B "Evening Timber" is a dark editorial art direction for a premium custom home builder: every home is shown at dusk, lit from within. It is a separate layout, not a recolour of Concept A.
How it meets the brief:
- All pages redesigned: Home (full-bleed hero, service index, project rail, sticky process), Projects (editorial case rows), About & Process, Contact
- Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile
- Type: Fraunces + Jost. Palette: Ink #121110, Smoke #262421, Bone #EDE6DA, Timber #A0714B, Brass #C9A86A
- Micro-interactions: hover thumbnails on services, rotating brass CTAs, marquee, slow cinematic reveals
- Handover style guide with tokens, spacing rules and live components
Ellery & Stone is a placeholder brand, so your copy, logo and photography drop straight in. Delivered as HTML/CSS/JS source + SVG art + style guide (importable into Figma). Revisions welcome.
